title: The Business of the Pumpkin Patch
short_teaser: A pumpkin patch may combine farming, hospitality, events, food, photography, and family tradition.
story: A pumpkin patch may combine farming, hospitality, events, food, photography, and family tradition. Its value comes from turning a seasonal product into an experience people remember. A business can grow when it understands the larger experience customers are actually choosing. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
